title: Issue #210: [P2] Define Sybil/fraud resistance, dispute handling and compute reputation model
content:
State: open

## Goal
Document and test the threat model for adversarial or colluding compute workers before production settlement depends on distributed results.

## Scope
Define worker admission, Sybil cost/controls, collusion assumptions, reputation inputs, challenge/dispute flow, penalties/appeals, privacy and economics.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Threat model identifies adversaries, trust assumptions, attack surfaces and residual risks.
- [ ] Reputation cannot be inflated solely by self-reported metrics or unaudited signatures.
- [ ] Dispute/challenge flow has explicit timing, evidence, resolution and settlement behavior.
- [ ] Privacy, retention and audit redaction rules are documented.
- [ ] Abuse/adversarial tests and measurable exit thresholds are specified.
- [ ] No production-readiness claim is made until independent review and evidence are complete.

## Dependencies
Multi-node worker path and result-verification model.
